profile.visual_desc: A muscular human warrior seen from behind. He wears dark grey-green, bulky shoulder armor and greaves, with a teal cloth hanging from his waist over dark pants. His arms are bare and deeply tanned. In the portrait, he has spiky reddish-brown hair held back by a thick blue headband, and wears blue fingerless gloves.
profile.face_cutin_desc: A dramatic close-up profile facing left. He has a strong jawline, a prominent nose, and spiky reddish-brown hair kept out of his serious, brown eyes by a thick blue headband. His expression is stoic and determined. He wears blue fingerless gloves and a hint of yellow-trimmed armor with a blue gem on the shoulder is visible.
profile.weapon_desc: A large, silver battleaxe held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Seen from a rear-isometric angle facing top-left. Hano stands with legs apart in a ready stance, holding the battleaxe in his right hand, resting near his waist.
profile.step2_windup: He raises the axe high above his head and slightly behind his right shoulder, shifting his weight and coiling his upper body for a powerful overhead swing.
profile.step3_impact: He swings the axe down forcefully to the left. A massive, broad wedge of solid, bright pale yellow light engulfs the upper half of the frame, originating from the axe head and expanding upwards and outwards to the top right, indicating a colossal energy impact.
profile.step4_finish: The solid yellow light vanishes, leaving a brief, fading trail of orange and yellow streaks along the axe's path. He holds the low follow-through pose, leaning forward, before returning to a neutral stance.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The massive, solid pale yellow energy wedge must erupt from the axe head exactly as it strikes downward in the bottom-left frame, completely filling the upper right area.

evaluation.diagnosis: The animation sequence aligns with the reference windup and swing logic. VFX timing and perspective remain stable throughout.
